evidence_basis: 20 competitor sites readable, 10 China export factory sites, 10 overseas packaging company sites, 12 schema-signal sites, 15 contact/RFQ-signal sites.
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
title: Rigid Gift Boxes v22 Buyer Decision SourceBridge
buyer_questions: What should buyers confirm before sampling rigid gift boxes?
How should magnetic, drawer, lid-and-base and folding structures be compared?
Which insert and finish details belong in a premium gift box RFQ?
domestic_competitor_takeaway: China export factory sites usually make product categories, factory language and quote entry visible. Use this as a cue for clear product-route and RFQ entry, not for unsupported low-price or fixed-MOQ claims.
overseas_competitor_takeaway: Overseas packaging company sites rely more on resources, sustainability framing, buyer education and solution pages. Use this as a cue for checklists, comparison tables and decision support before RFQ.
avoid_points: Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or lowest price.
Do not claim FSC, FDA, food-contact suitability, destination-market compliance or certification unless a valid document is reviewed.
Do not present unverified customer cases, production capacity, platform badges or partnerships as facts.
Do not copy competitor wording; only reuse structure, intent and page logic.
counting_boundary: This SourceBridge is public source-routing and buyer-education evidence only. It is not proof of Google ranking, GSC clicks, GA4 traffic, AI natural recommendation, inquiry generation, customer case, endorsement, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or fixed price.
